## Teaching philosophy

::: {.lead}
More than **400 hours of teaching (TD equivalent)** since 2021, delivered to a variety of audiences (Licence, BUT, Bachelor in finance) in France and Cameroon.
:::

Active pedagogy based on case studies, mentoring of entrepreneurial projects and supervision of SAE final-year defences. Current courses are aligned with business school standards: **entrepreneurship, management, change management, business plan, financial markets**.
